name: When is it necessary to do a full gut remodel instead of surface repairs?

mainEntity.name: When is it necessary to do a full gut remodel instead of surface repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a full remodel if you notice persistent leaks, loose or cracked tiles, mold growth, or soft spots in the flooring around the toilet and shower. Soft flooring and musty smells frequently indicate chronic moisture penetration beneath tile underlayment, which can compromise floor joists and wall studs. Beyond water damage, a full remodel is justified when poor layouts create pinch points, storage is inadequate, or outdated galvanized plumbing leads to low water pressure. Correcting these issues requires full access to the framing and rough utility systems.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full gut remodel is necessary when there is hidden water damage, soft subfloors, persistent mold, or outdated plumbing that simple surface repairs cannot fix.
